control.detail: the depth-3 run publishes all eight members yet REA reports partial; a file-count-only reading calls it complete

rev_use_in_tool: no other read; the counter builds its own chain and never reads the repo
A8_vacuity: deepest-analyzed is all() over expected[p][1] == depth == 4; expected levels are 1,2,3, so the set is empty and the term is true; the level-3 assertion is carried by analyzed-through-budget
control_entailment: fires = len(files)==len(expected) and coverage != 'complete'; A1 path-set-equal gives the count and A3 requires coverage partial, so the control cannot fail while A1+A3 hold

ownership_sensitivity.conclusion: -repro-time fixes timestamps only; uid/gid are source-owned, so pins are host/user-bound and the tool never passes -all-root/-force-uid/-force-gid

working_tree_drift.diff: removal of unused 'import tempfile' (no semantic change, but the pinned digest no longer describes the executed file)

class_boundary.measured: lane-built, three-level, standard little-endian SquashFS v4, gzip, block 4096, mksquashfs 4.7.5, REA 6.5.0 / unblob 26.6.4, whole-file nested carriers, regular files only
not_measured: more than one container per level
